args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
===========================

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (light, breathable clothing)
- Camera (with waterproof case if possible)
- Travel documents (passport, ID, hotel confirmations, flight info)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Flip flops/sandals
- Light jacket for evenings
- Rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers and adapters
- Beach bag

Don't forget to check weather forecasts before finalizing your packing!
